title: The EC introduces draft revisions to the EU's Cybersecurity Act to phase out equipment from high-risk suppliers in critical sectors, a move criticized by Huawei (Foo Yun Chee/Reuters)
summary: Foo Yun Chee / Reuters: The EC introduces draft revisions to the EU's Cybersecurity Act to phase out equipment from high-risk suppliers in critical sectors, a move criticized by Huawei — The EU plans to phase out components and equipment from high-risk suppliers in critical sectors, according to a draft proposal released …
